GSI is the premier geohazard mitigation firm specializing in emergency slope stabilization, landslide repair, grouting, and micropiles through innovative design-build delivery. Access Limited brings over a century of steep-slope expertise and operates North America’s largest fleet of spider excavators, delivering complex rockfall and geotechnical solutions in the most challenging environments. RoadGuard, founded in 2024, unites industry-leading roadway safety companies providing guardrail, bridge railing, highway signage, fencing, and specialty fabrication services. Across all our businesses, we are driven by innovation, extreme ownership, technical excellence, and a relentless commitment to measurable results that improve safety and infrastructure resilience. NOTE: GSI is not sponsoring VISA holders or relocating for this role. You must be within commutable distance AND have a US Citizenship/Permanent Residency to be considered. GSI is looking for a Systems Administrator I/II to own the reliability, performance, and security of our on-premises and cloud infrastructure. This is a hands-on technical role, but it's also a proving ground. We are not hiring for adequacy — we are hiring for excellence: candidates with the intellectual horsepower, resilience, and results orientation to take extreme ownership of GSI's systems and scale into senior engineering or IT leadership. Outcomes matter more than hours logged or tickets closed. Level (I or II) is determined by the candidate's demonstrated experience and technical depth. Core Responsibilities Install, configure, and maintain Windows servers, virtualization platforms, and cloud infrastructure (e.g., Azure). Monitor system performance, capacity, and availability, and proactively resolve issues before they impact users. Administer Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and identity/access management systems. Manage system backups; perform regular updates and file/server recovery testing. Apply security patches and best-practice configurations to servers and appliances. Support network infrastructure including switches, firewalls, VPNs, and wireless access points. Maintain accurate documentation of systems, configurations, and standard operating procedures. Provide Tier 2/3 escalation support for end-user hardware, software, and connectivity issues. Ensure compliance with organizational security policies and relevant regulatory requirements. Identify and drive opportunities to automate routine administration, monitoring, and support work, including through AI-assisted tools — we expect this role to reduce manual toil over time, not just keep the lights on. Bring a team-based, solutions-first approach to cross-functional problem solving, and exercise strategic judgment under pressure rather than simply escalating. Required Qualifications Associate's or bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience. Hands-on experience administering Windows Servers and cloud environments. Working knowledge of Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy. Working experience with Azure, Entra, and Microsoft Exchange. Knowledge of MDM for device management; Microsoft Intune a plus. Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, or equivalent). Familiarity with networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, firewalls). Understanding of ZTNA for local infrastructure. Understanding of backup/disaster recovery tools and practices. Strong troubleshooting skills and demonstrated ability to work independently under time pressure. Clear written and verbal communication skills for documentation and end-user support. Willingness to work occasional off-hours for maintenance windows or emergencies. Preferred Qualifications Experience with cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud). Scripting and automation experience (PowerShell and AI tools). Experience with endpoint management tools (Intune a plus). Exposure to ITSM/ticketing platforms (local and remote support systems). Relevant certifications: CompTIA Network+/Security+, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator. Technical Environment Operating Systems: Windows Server (2016+), Windows 10/11 Virtualization/Cloud: Hyper-V / Azure Directory & Identity: Active Directory, Azure AD/Entra ID Networking: Aruba switches and access points, Dell and HP servers, FortiGate firewall Backup: Veeam (local NAS and cloud) Ticketing/ITSM: SolarWinds Work Environment & Physical Requirements This is an on-site role based at GSI's Westminster, CO headquarters, on our hybrid schedule; candidates willing to relocate to Westminster or work from one of GSI's remote office hubs are preferred. Night and weekend work as needed to complete maintenance during non-business hours. Must be able to lift and move IT equipment. GSI is built on innovation, extreme ownership, and mission-driven engineering. If you're looking for a role where you clock in and follow a script, this isn't it — we're looking for someone who wants to grow with the business. US pay range for this role. $71,000—$88,000 USD Soil Nail Holdings and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity employers. review_candidates.title: Manager, IT Infrastructure (Network & Cloud)
review_candidates.description: Employment Status Regular Time Type Full time BUILDING A WORLD CLASS TEAM STARTS WITH YOU At the heart of CSA Group is a vision: making the world a better, safer, more sustainable place. It's been part of our mission for nearly one hundred years: from the first engineering standard for railway bridges developed in 1919, to more than 3,500 standards, codes & related products today. Headquartered in Canada, with a global footprint of more than 30 labs and offices across Europe, Asia and North America, CSA Group tests, inspects and certifies a wide range of products - from every day househould items to leading edge technology-to meet exacting requirements for safety, performance and environmental impact. Our employees take pride in making a difference in people's lives through the work that we do. We're looking for people like you to help make it happen. Job Summary CSA Group has an immediate opportunity for a Manager, IT Infrastructure (Network & Cloud) to provide senior technical leadership over the design, implementation, operation, and security of CSA Group's hybrid infrastructure estate — spanning the global network, on-premises compute and storage, and the Microsoft cloud environment. This role builds, secures, patches, and monitors infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments, and is accountable for network and compute security posture, patch and vulnerability currency, and demonstrated recoverability through tested backup and disaster recovery capability. The position translates business requirements into cost-effective technical solutions, directs third-party managed service providers and system integrators, and recommends and implements new technologies to support revenue growth, operational efficiency, and risk management. Responsibilities Designs, implements, and operates the global WAN/SD-WAN, LAN, wireless, and structured cable plant, including routing, switching, and network segmentation. Configures, maintains, and audits firewalls, VPN, and remote access, including zero trust and multi-factor authentication integration. Builds and operates the on-premises virtualization platform, Windows Server and Linux environments, and core directory, identity, and name resolution services. Provisions and maintains SAN/NAS storage, and directs physical work in server rooms and data centre facilities, including cabling, power, cooling, and secure decommissioning. Designs, builds, secures, and operates Microsoft Azure infrastructure and administers the Microsoft 365 tenant, including hybrid identity and hybrid connectivity to on-premises environments. Applies hardening baselines and secure configuration standards, and manages privileged access, secrets, and certificates across network, compute, and cloud workloads. Plans and executes patch cycles, triages vulnerability scan output and vendor advisories, and remediates within change control. Administers enterprise backup and replication platforms, designs retention and immutability schedules, and performs and evidences scheduled restore testing. Maintains disaster recovery and business continuity plans, runbooks, and failover procedures, and plans and executes DR exercises with the business. Participates in security incident response, including containment, evidence preservation, remediation, and post-incident hardening. Administers infrastructure monitoring, alerting, and log management across network, compute, storage, and cloud, and produces availability, capacity, and performance trend reporting. Directs and holds accountable managed service providers, system integrators, and security partners engaged to deliver or support infrastructure services. Raises and documents changes for approval, communicates impact and maintenance windows, and maintains infrastructure diagrams, standards, runbooks, and configuration records. Automates repetitive build, configuration, patching, and reporting tasks to reduce manual effort and configuration drift across the estate. Acts as senior escalation point and technical mentor for complex infrastructure incidents, and leads root cause analysis and permanent corrective action for major outages. Provides guidance, coaching, and knowledge transfer to IT Technical Specialists and site IT staff, and consults on regional office and site infrastructure initiatives. Provides evidence and technical input for internal and external audits, accreditation, and regulatory information security assessments. Monitors cloud consumption and infrastructure spend, identifies rightsizing and optimization opportunities, and manages licence, support, and maintenance renewals. Understands the importance of HSE, reports hazards and incidents, completes assigned training, and participates in workplace inspections and audits. Education & Experience 3-year technical diploma or university degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering Technology, Network Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Eight to twelve (8-12) years of progressive experience in enterprise infrastructure, including at least three to five (3-5) years operating as a senior or lead technical resource with end-to-end accountability for a production environment. Demonstrated hands-on experience across network (routing, switching, firewalls, VPN, wireless, SD-WAN), virtualization and Windows Server (with working Linux capability), SAN/NAS storage, and enterprise backup and replication platforms. Demonstrated hands-on experience building and operating Microsoft Azure infrastructure and administering a Microsoft 365 tenant, including hybrid identity and connectivity. Experience managing vendors, carriers, managed service providers, and system integrators, including scope, service levels, and deliverable acceptance. Skills Must have exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical matters to non-technical stakeholders. Strong project, time management, and leadership skills, with the ability to manage operational demand and project commitments concurrently. Demonstrated experience applying hardening standards, managing privileged access, and executing patch and vulnerability remediation across network and compute infrastructure. Demonstrated experience designing, executing, and evidencing backup, restore, and disaster recovery testing against defined recovery objectives. Working proficiency in scripting and automation, with exposure to infrastructure as code. Position requirements demand initiative, creativity, integrity, and technical excellence. Desire to learn and become familiar with new technologies, and ability to assimilate knowledge quickly and effectively. Certifications considered an asset: Cisco CCNA/CCNP or equivalent (Fortinet NSE, Palo Alto PCNSA/PCNSE, Juniper JNCIA/JNCIS, Aruba ACSA/ACSP); Microsoft AZ-104; AZ-800/801 (or consolidated AZ-802); AZ-500 (or SC-500); MS-102; VMware VCP-VVF/VCF; CompTIA Network+, Server+, or Security+; ITIL Foundation; Veeam VMCE. This is a hybrid position requiring regular in-person attendance and punctuality in accordance with Company policies. Additionally, the ability to interact well with other employees and work overtime, as necessary, is required. The typical hiring range for this position is $116,230 - $152,555, however, based on a variety of considerations (such as education, licenses, certifications and/or experience,) CSA Group reserves the right to flexibility outside of the stated range. CSA Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on any grounds stipulated by applicable laws. We are an organization where opportunities are based on skills and abilities, and differences are respected and valued. Please contact us at talentacquisition@csagroup.org if you require accommodation in the interview process.

Manage maintenance tasks and maintain meticulous inventory records of all servers and server-related equipment and software. Develop and uphold standard procedures for routine and recurring activities, ensuring efficiency and consistency. Proficient knowledge of LDAP, DHCP, DNS. Proficiency in Perl, PowerShell, Windows scripting, and standard shell scripts. Excellent verbal, written, and communication skills, coupled with strong judgment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Must be able to: Lift up to 25 lbs. Bend, stretch, squat, kneel, to move equipment, set up workstations (projectors, TV screens, computers, servers, routers, printers, tools, etc.). Must be able to present acceptable identification for customer badging and site access, such as a REAL ID compliant driver license, U.S. Passport, or other approved document from the GSA Required Identification List .
